scripts.setup: npm --prefix frontend install && cd backend && uv sync
scripts.dev: concurrently -n front,back -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.dev:frontend: cross-env VITE_API_BASE=http://localhost:8000 npm --prefix frontend run dev
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn bfps.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend run test -- --run && cd backend && uv run pytest
